transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

Yeah… I came in because something happened at work. I was in a staff meeting and I got really worked up, and I started acting out this whole fall-prevention drill—moving chairs around, waving my arms, showing people like it was happening right then.  

I couldn’t really stop myself, even when people were telling me to sit down. It was embarrassing, and I think it scared some folks, so… that’s why I’m here.
Before that meeting, had you been feeling unusually energetic or elated?

Yeah, I had been feeling kind of… up. Like bright, fired up, like things were finally clicking and I had all this energy to get stuff done.

But it also turned quick. If someone slowed me down or questioned what I was doing, I’d snap at them harder than I meant to.
Have you been needing much less sleep than usual?

Yeah. I mean, I’d sleep maybe two or three hours, then wake up before it was even light out feeling like I was ready to start the day.

I’d be up making plans while the house was still dark, and at the time it didn’t seem strange to me. I didn’t really feel tired like I normally would.
During this time, have you heard voices or felt certain of things that other people said weren’t true?

Yeah… during those times, I did. I was hearing calls that weren’t really there, like someone calling out or trying to get my attention, but nobody had said anything.

And I got really sure my supervisor was setting traps for me at work. Other people told me that didn’t make sense, but at the time I felt certain about it.
Did the voices or beliefs about your supervisor happen only when you were feeling unusually up and energetic?

No, not only then. There was a calmer stretch too, where I was sleeping more normal and I wasn’t rushing around doing projects.

But even then, for several weeks, I’d still hear my name being called when nobody was there. And I still felt pretty sure people at work were keeping notes on me.
Have you had a time when you felt very depressed and, during that time, still heard voices or felt people were watching or plotting against you?

I’m not really sure about that. I’ve had times I felt pretty low, but I can’t clearly say the voices or the feeling watched was tied to that the way you’re asking.

I’d have to think more on it.
Was there ever a stretch of at least two weeks when you were hearing voices or felt people were plotting against you, but you were not feeling especially up or especially depressed?

Yes. There was a stretch like that. I wasn’t feeling real up or wired, and I wasn’t especially depressed either. I was sleeping more normal, not running around starting projects.

But for several weeks I was still hearing my name being called when nobody was there, and I still felt like people at work were keeping notes on me.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed nearly every day?
I’m not sure. I’ve had low periods, yeah, but I don’t know if it was nearly every day for two weeks straight. I didn’t really track it like that.
Have you ever had a time when you felt down or depressed nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I still can’t say for sure. I’ve had times where I was down for a while, but I don’t know if it was nearly every day for a full two weeks. I wasn’t keeping track like that.
Have you ever had a time when you felt depressed nearly every day for two weeks or longer?
I really don’t know. I’ve had times where I felt pretty down, but I can’t honestly say it was nearly every day for two weeks or longer. I wasn’t paying that close attention to it.
Have you ever had a period when you felt depressed nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I’m not really sure. I know I’ve had stretches where I felt low, but I can’t say it was nearly every day for two weeks. I just wasn’t keeping track like that.
At any time in your life, have you had a period when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I don’t really know how to answer that. I’ve had times where I felt down a lot, but I can’t say for sure it was most of the day nearly every day. I didn’t really track it like that.
Have you ever lost interest or pleasure in almost everything you usually enjoy for two weeks or longer?
I’m not sure. I’ve had times where I didn’t feel like doing much, but I can’t say I lost interest in almost everything for two weeks or longer. I don’t really remember it that clearly.
Looking back over the whole time you’ve been unwell, have the voices or suspicious beliefs been present for most of that time?
Yeah, I think so. The suspicious thoughts and the hearing calls that aren’t really there have been going on for about nine months now.
During these past nine months, was there ever a time when you felt depressed nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had low periods during that time, but I can’t say it was nearly every day for two weeks straight. I don’t remember it that clearly.
During these nine months, have there also been long stretches when you were not feeling especially up or depressed, but the voices or suspicious beliefs were still there?

Yeah. There was a calmer stretch where I wasn’t really up or down. I was sleeping more normal, not running around trying to do projects or anything. But even then, for several weeks, I’d still hear my name being called, and I still thought people at work were keeping notes on me.
Have you ever had a time when you felt extremely energized or high for at least one week?

Yeah, I’ve had stretches like that. I feel really bright and fired up, like everything’s finally coming together. But if somebody slows me down or questions what I’m doing, I can snap pretty hard, harder than I mean to.
When you were hearing your name being called during that calmer stretch, were you feeling completely back to your usual self emotionally?

Yeah, I was more like myself mood-wise, I guess. I wasn’t all revved up or really down, and my sleep was more normal. But the voices were still happening for weeks, hearing my name, and I still thought people at work were keeping notes on me.
Over these nine months, have the times when your mood was clearly high or energized lasted for most of that time?
Yeah, I think so. Looking back, the high-energy times — where I had all these big plans and got irritated real easy — they took up more of the nine months than the calmer stretches did.
Have the voices or suspicious beliefs been going on for at least six months in total?
Yeah, it’s been at least six months. More like about nine months now that I’ve had the suspicious thoughts and hearing my name or calls when nobody’s there.
